events.event: A global Microsoft 365 outage took down Outlook and Teams, with CNN Indonesia reporting 74 countries affected, including government services in Singapore and Japan and Australian intelligence and police agencies; Microsoft said it was not a cyberattack.
events.key_numbers: 74 countries affected · 13 Nov 2026 · not a cyberattack per Microsoft
events.why_it_matters: Office and email tools many Indonesian workers and agencies depend on went dark worldwide, showing how fragile cloud dependence is.
events.spreading_evidence: About 16 CNN Indonesia teknologi headlines on 13 Nov were Microsoft-outage related

events.event: Komdigi and BSSN issued account-security advice after the Microsoft outage, and a bank warned customers about scam modus exploiting it.
events.why_it_matters: Scammers piggyback on big outages, so ordinary users are told to be wary of fake support messages.

events.event: Komdigi responded to SAFEnet and Remotivi claims about takedowns of wildfire (karhutla) content, saying it is ready to open its data and review its moderation.
events.why_it_matters: Raises the question of whether the government is suppressing posts about the haze and fires.

events.event: United Airlines blocked AI agents from booking tickets on behalf of users, citing passenger data security and federal rules.
events.why_it_matters: An early test of whether AI assistants will be allowed to buy things for people.

events.event: Nvidia named CFO Colette Kress interim CEO after Jensen Huang resigned, and CNN Indonesia listed possible successors including Tim Cook.
events.why_it_matters: The leader of the world's most important AI chip maker is gone, which could affect chip supply and prices.
events.spreading_evidence: Multiple CNN Indonesia teknologi headlines 13 Nov
